context: Two teens debrief a chill after-school hangout
purpose: Teach: ただただ/なんらかの/あがり/かえる/愉快/平凡/悪口/手足

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日のカラオケ、ただただ楽しかったね。
lines.en: Today's karaoke was just purely fun.
lines.style: Cheerful teen girl, casual after-school tone with warm energy

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: マジで愉快だったわ。俺が歌った時、声が裏返って変なテンションあがりまくってたし。
lines.en: It was seriously a blast. When I sang, my voice cracked and my weird hype went up like crazy.
lines.style: Laid-back teen boy laughing at himself with casual self-deprecating energy

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あれはさ、平凡な火曜日が急に伝説になった瞬間だって。
lines.en: That was the moment an ordinary Tuesday suddenly turned legendary, I'm telling you.
lines.style: Animated teen girl hyping up the moment with playful exaggeration

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: やめてって、なんらかの形で一生いじられる未来しか見えないんだけど。
lines.en: Stop, I can only see a future where I get teased about it forever in some form.
lines.style: Embarrassed teen boy laughing while weakly protesting his fate

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 悪口じゃないって、ただのいじりだよ。みんな手足バタバタさせて爆笑してたじゃん。
lines.en: It's not trash talk, just teasing. Everyone was flailing their arms and legs cracking up.
lines.style: Reassuring teen girl with bright giggling delivery and animated gestures

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: まあ確かにな。そろそろ家にかえるけど、来週もまた集まろうぜ。
lines.en: Yeah, fair enough. I'm heading home soon, but let's hang out again next week.
lines.style: Relaxed teen boy wrapping up the chat in an easygoing way

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 了解、駅まで一緒に歩こう。
lines.en: Got it, let's walk to the station together.
lines.style: Friendly teen girl closing the conversation with warm casual tone
